data.body: The 2026-11-04 MCP fsck (production, read-only, image 4496e9acd2a) now reports the 23 files on one tracker_dirty_untracked_event row (counted: false), with the detail '23 of 23 have a tracked .retired copy at HEAD'. The 2 .tmp-event files are still on the tracker_dirty_tmp_event row. snapshot_inconsistent is now 0. The files are unchanged; this ticket still tracks their removal.
